Workspace.description: Several children side by side as panels a person can arrange: drag a panel by its heading to another column or to an edge for a column of its own, resize with the dividers, and hide or show panels from a rail. `layout.columns` says where the panels are: a list of columns from left to right, each a list of panel ids from top to bottom, so search on the left and a map on the right is `[["search"], ["map"]]`. To rearrange, send the component again with a new `layout`; how a person left it comes back to you in the surface's controls as `layout`. Panels not placed are added to the last column. Each panel shows on a rail as an icon, with its name in a tooltip and, when a person turns names on, a short name under it: keep titles to a few words, and give `short` and `icon` so the rail reads well. Use it when a person will work across several views at once; use Grid or Row for a fixed arrangement.
